pages.title: Axiom Stone
pages.text: Pale, smooth stone that seems to be made of definitions. Each block holds its shape because it has been told to. It is cool and faintly humming, like a theorem being proved. Its surface is unmarked except for faint, regular lines, like ruled paper for a proof yet to be written.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the realm of axioms, everything rests on this stone. I mined a piece to see what it was and found it underlay both the natural numbers and the axiom schemas I had been studying.
